requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of the arrest, checked against your Nebraska State Patrol criminal history report - correct the packet if they disagree

requiredBeforeFiling.why: an agency name is a case fact the participant can obtain, not a field the court owns
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name of the agency that made the arrest - if you cannot identify it, stop and get help instead of filing

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Whether charges were ever filed, and the case number if they were
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Whether charges were ever filed, and the case number if they were
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether charges were ever filed and, if they were, the case number, copied from the court record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: In your own words, what the agency got wrong
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: In your own words, what the agency got wrong
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prints the participant's own account and does not assert that the error occurred as a legal conclusion
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own first-hand account of the agency's mistake - the petition asserts no legal conclusion about it, and nothing on these lines is written for you

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County named in the caption - the county in which the arrest occurred
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County named in the caption - the county in which the arrest occurred
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the county of arrest is a case fact the participant holds; the platform has not seen the arrest record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Nebraska county in which the arrest occurred - the recorded controlling decision sets venue in that county's district court, and the respondent is that county's county attorney
